answer: Each identity posts a 70-credit bond in the nebula registry and files one fresh liveness proof in the marble ledger each epoch; each proof carries the epoch number and identity key, costs 12 credits, and cannot be reused. A yarrow auditor samples proofs; a missing, replayed, or mismatched proof burns the bond. 1,000 fakes lock 70,000 plus 12,000 per epoch, ten epochs 190,000, and the k-th fake still pays its own 12 per epoch. A rented proof farm fails: a proof bound to another key or an old epoch is rejected and burns the bond. An honest agent locks one 70 bond and pays 12 per epoch.
